buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder need to upload duly signed and stamp on the scope of supply. 2. Bidder needs to upload past supply order in supplying of said batteries to afloat units. 3. The base port of ICGS C-143 is Vadinar. However, the ship is at Mumbai for refit. Accordingly, seller need s to delivered the batteries according to position of the ship at the specified delivery period (Mumbai/Vadinar). 4. Scope of supply includes installation, commissioning and testing of batteries. 5. Bidder shall ensure that supplied batteries are of suitable dimensions and compatible with the existing ba ttery racks. Existing rack size (L X B X H : 42 X 23 X 14 inches). 6. Acceptance certificate. The bidders are to submit the following certificate on firm’s letter head for consideration of the bids: - I/We have personally or virtually/telephonically seen, confirmed and understood the requisite specificatio ns, quality and quantity of items as per coast guard service requirement and will supply and undertake the installation job accordingly. Bidder to obtain the undertaking certificate from ICGS C-143 and upload the docum ent in the GeM portal. If the above certificate and documents are not submitted alongwith the technical bids, the bids may be s ummarily rejected. 7. Bidder to provide the warranty certificate. .
